tldr: 三星繳出創紀錄獲利卻仍不及華爾街對 AI 的高標準，引爆全球晶片股賣壓，拖累台股與美股科技類股走弱。
伊朗在荷莫茲海峽攻擊油輪、美國撤銷伊朗售油許可，油價大漲，重新點燃供給衝擊與通膨疑慮。
台積電將召開七月法說會，外資因 AI／高效能運算需求上修目標價，續為左右台股方向的風向球。
財政部研擬收緊「擬制遺產」規範，將過世前兩年內贈與親屬的財產併入遺產課稅，並由受贈人負擔稅負。
強制汽車責任險身故與失能理賠上限自七月起提高至 300 萬元，擴大駕駛人的基礎保障。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫逾千點、跌幅2.3%，全球晶片賣壓襲台
items.title_en: TAIEX slides 2.3% as global chip rout hits Taiwan tech
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數7月7日收在約45,479點，單日重挫約1,077點、跌幅約2.3%，為近期較大的單日回檔，全球半導體賣壓蔓延至本地科技股。此波下跌反映美股那斯達克前一夜走弱——三星財報未能滿足市場對 AI 需求的高度期待，引爆晶片股賣壓。權值龍頭台積電相對抗跌，收在約2,440元，但 IC 設計、設備與零組件族群普遍走弱，拖累大盤。法人多將此視為今年稍早創高後的健康整理，後市焦點轉向即將登場的第二季法說會，觀察下半年需求展望是否足以支撐指數再攻高。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX closed near 45,479 on July 7, shedding about 1,077 points (roughly 2.3%) in one of its sharper single-session pullbacks, as a worldwide semiconductor selloff spilled into local tech names. The decline tracked overnight weakness on the Nasdaq, where chip stocks tumbled after Samsung's earnings failed to satisfy elevated AI demand expectations. Index heavyweight TSMC proved relatively resilient, closing around NT$2,440, but broad weakness across IC design, equipment and component suppliers dragged the wider market. Traders framed the drop as a healthy consolidation after a strong run to record highs earlier in the year, with attention now turning to the coming wave of second-quarter earnings calls for guidance on second-half demand.

items.title_zh: 法說會前外資上修台積電目標價
items.title_en: Foreign brokers lift TSMC targets ahead of July earnings call
items.summary_zh: 台積電七月法說會登場前，多家外資券商調升目標價，並視此為左右整體市場方向的重要訊號。據報導，瑞銀將台積電2026年美元營收年增預估上修至約37%，看好高效能運算需求加速、未來數年可望貢獻大部分營收。分析師形容法說會是財報確認 AI 資本支出循環前的「最後上車機會」，惟部分外資同時對大盤示警三大整理訊號。長線 AI 結構性需求的多頭論述，與短線獲利了結壓力相互拉鋸，正牽動法人於下半年財報季的布局節奏。
items.summary_en: Ahead of TSMC's July legal-investor conference, several foreign brokerages have raised their price targets, casting the event as a directional signal for the whole market. UBS reportedly nudged its 2026 U.S.-dollar revenue growth estimate for TSMC up toward 37%, citing accelerating high-performance-computing demand that could account for the bulk of revenue in coming years. Analysts see the call as the "last chance to board" before results confirm the AI capex cycle, though some foreign houses simultaneously flagged three consolidation signals for the broader index. The tug-of-war between bullish long-term AI structural demand and near-term profit-taking is shaping how institutions position into the second-half reporting season.

items.title_zh: 外資示警台股三大整理訊號
items.title_en: Analysts flag three consolidation signals for TAIEX
items.summary_zh: 在指數逼近歷史高點之際，外資分析師示警三大技術面整理訊號，並認為相較被動追蹤指數，「主動」選股的價值正逐漸浮現。此番謹慎正值七月科技法說會密集登場、除息旺季來臨，兩者通常帶來波動。策略師指出，上半年強勁上漲後，類股輪動與選股紀律的重要性高於一味追高指數，尤其全球晶片情緒轉趨脆弱之際更是如此。對投資人的提醒是：預期盤勢震盪加劇，聚焦具備明確 AI、DRAM 與消費性電子下半年需求能見度的個股。
items.summary_en: With the index near historic highs, foreign analysts warned of three technical consolidation signals and argued that value is emerging in "active" stock selection rather than passive index exposure. The caution comes as July brings a dense calendar of technology earnings calls and the ex-dividend season, both of which typically inject volatility. Strategists suggest that after a powerful first-half rally, rotation and stock-picking discipline matter more than chasing the index, especially with global chip sentiment turning fragile. The message to investors is to expect choppier trading and to focus on companies with clear AI, DRAM and consumer-electronics demand visibility into the second half.

items.title_zh: 台積電加速2奈米、3奈米擴產
items.title_en: TSMC accelerates 2nm and 3nm capacity expansion
items.summary_zh: 為滿足 AI 與高效能運算的爆量訂單，台積電積極擴充最先進製程產能，3奈米月產能預計由2025年底約12萬片，成長至2028年約22萬片，2奈米首年亦大幅放量。據報導，瑞銀將台積電2026年美元營收年增預估上修至約37%，預期未來數年高效能運算將占營收三分之二以上。此波擴產撐起龐大的設備與材料供應鏈，而先進封裝正浮現為下一個瓶頸。對出口導向的台灣經濟而言，台積電的資本支出軌跡仍是檢視 AI 投資循環續航力的核心指標，牽動整條供應鏈的接單能見度。
items.summary_en: TSMC is ramping its most advanced process nodes to meet surging AI and high-performance-computing orders, with 3nm capacity projected to climb from roughly 120,000 wafers per month at end-2025 toward around 220,000 by 2028, alongside a steep first-year 2nm ramp. UBS reportedly lifted TSMC's 2026 U.S.-dollar revenue growth estimate to about 37%, expecting HPC to make up two-thirds or more of revenue in coming years. The expansion underpins a broad supply chain of equipment and materials vendors, even as advanced packaging emerges as the next bottleneck. For Taiwan's export-driven economy, TSMC's capex trajectory remains a core barometer of the AI investment cycle's durability.

items.title_zh: 先進封裝成 AI 下一個瓶頸
items.title_en: Advanced packaging becomes the next AI bottleneck
items.summary_zh: 產業分析指出，先進封裝（CoWoS、SoIC、CoPoS）正成為 AI 晶片供應鏈的新瓶頸，部分外資估 CoWoS 產能缺口達20%至30%以上。隨推論運算需求超越訓練、人形機器人邁向量產元年，高頻寬封裝需求跑在供給之前。此缺口嘉惠一大批台灣設備、材料與封裝供應商，使先進封裝從景氣循環題材升級為結構性成長主軸。投資人也在 AI 族群內部加速分化，較偏好直接受惠於封裝、散熱與記憶體的個股，而非全面式的概念股布局，凸顯選股將取代齊漲齊跌成為下階段主旋律。
items.summary_en: Industry analysis points to advanced packaging—CoWoS, SoIC and CoPoS—as the emerging constraint in the AI chip supply chain, with the CoWoS capacity gap estimated by some foreign houses at 20% to 30% or more. As inference workloads overtake training and humanoid robotics approach mass production, demand for high-bandwidth packaging is running ahead of supply. The squeeze benefits a wide swath of Taiwanese equipment, materials and packaging suppliers, positioning先進封裝 as a structural growth theme rather than a cyclical one. Investors are increasingly differentiating within the AI complex, favoring names with direct leverage to packaging, thermal management and memory rather than broad-brush exposure.

items.title_zh: 推論需求超越訓練，AI 股邁入新階段
items.title_en: AI stocks enter a new phase as inference overtakes training
items.summary_zh: 市場評論認為，2026年 AI 題材股進入新階段，由四大訊號驅動：推論需求超越訓練、人形機器人量產元年、CoWoS 供給缺口持續擴大，以及台積電上修營收展望。此一轉變意味 AI 行情正從少數 GPU 個股，擴散至封裝、散熱、ASIC、ABF 與 HBM 等供應鏈。對台廠而言，需求多元化提供價值鏈上多個切入點，但估值墊高之際也要求更精準的選股。分析師提醒，單靠優於預期的財報恐已不足以取悅投資人，呼應海外財報後回檔的現象，凸顯下半年須以基本面能見度為核心篩選標的。
items.summary_en: Market commentary argues that 2026 marks a new stage for AI-themed equities, driven by four signals: inference demand surpassing training, the first year of humanoid-robot mass production, a widening CoWoS supply gap, and TSMC's raised revenue outlook. The shift implies that the AI trade is broadening beyond a handful of GPU names into packaging, thermal, ASIC, ABF and HBM supply chains. For Taiwanese manufacturers, this diversification of demand offers multiple entry points across the value chain, but also demands sharper stock selection as valuations stretch. Analysts caution that beating estimates alone may no longer satisfy investors, echoing post-earnings pullbacks seen abroad.

items.title_zh: 強制車險理賠上限自七月起提高至300萬元
items.title_en: Compulsory auto insurance payouts rise to NT$3 million from July
items.summary_zh: 台灣強制汽車責任保險自七月起，將身故與失能理賠上限提高至300萬元，強化事故受害人及其家屬的基礎保障。此調整由金管會保險局主管，反映主管機關定期檢討、使法定保障額度與攀升的醫療與生活成本接軌。由於強制險不論肇責、涵蓋所有已登記車輛，上限調高等同在不需加保的情況下擴大全體駕駛人的安全網。保險業者將在受監理的保費架構內吸收此變動。此舉凸顯主管機關在強制性保險領域對消費者保護的持續重視，也提醒車主檢視自身任意險保額是否足以銜接風險缺口。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's compulsory automobile liability insurance raised its maximum death and disability payout to NT$3 million starting in July, strengthening baseline protection for accident victims and their families. The adjustment, overseen by the Financial Supervisory Commission's Insurance Bureau, reflects periodic reviews that align statutory coverage with rising medical and living costs. Because the compulsory scheme covers all registered vehicles regardless of fault, the higher ceiling broadens the safety net across the driving population without requiring supplementary policies. Insurers will absorb the change within the regulated premium framework, and the move underscores the regulator's continued focus on consumer protection in mandatory lines of insurance.

items.title_zh: 金管會就清算款遭挪用裁罰中信銀
items.title_en: FSC sanctions CTBC Bank over misappropriated clearing funds
items.summary_zh: 金管會於7月2日就中國信託商業銀行前行員挪用該行 ATM 清算款及財金清算款所涉缺失，作出行政處分。此案針對使清算資金遭挪用的內部控制缺失——鑑於清算款涉及支付系統的系統性影響，主管機關向來嚴肅看待此類缺失。此類裁罰通常要求補強控制缺口、追究人員責任並強化清算作業的監控。本案再次提醒台灣各銀行，作業風險與清算款控管仍是監理重點；即使損失最終獲控制，主管機關仍願對缺失予以裁罰，凸顯內控與洗錢防制之外，資金清算流程的把關同樣不可鬆懈。
items.summary_en: On July 2 the Financial Supervisory Commission imposed administrative penalties on CTBC Bank in connection with a former employee's misappropriation of the bank's ATM settlement and interbank clearing funds. The action targets internal-control deficiencies that allowed clearing monies to be diverted, a category of failure the regulator treats seriously given its systemic implications for the payments system. Sanctions of this kind typically require remediation of control gaps, staff accountability and enhanced monitoring of settlement operations. The case is a reminder to Taiwan's banks that operational-risk and clearing-fund controls remain a priority supervisory theme, with the regulator willing to penalize lapses even where losses are ultimately contained.

items.title_zh: 境外基金金流大洗牌，投資人同追科技與收益
items.title_en: Offshore fund flows reshuffle as investors chase tech and income
items.summary_zh: 5月境外基金淨申贖排行顯示跨境金流出現大洗牌，投資人陷於既怕錯過行情、又怕追高的矛盾。資金一方面偏好強勢科技題材，一方面擁抱進階收益與多重收益商品；地區配置則由美國向亞太區域擴散。此格局反映「雙引擎」策略——以攻擊性科技部位搭配防禦性收益來源——正是財管業者對高資產客戶在高估值環境下日益推薦的做法。對私人銀行與財管團隊而言，此金流凸顯客戶對槓鈴式配置的需求：既參與 AI 驅動的上檔，又透過收益部位緩衝波動，成為下半年資產配置與商品銷售的核心命題。
items.summary_en: May's offshore fund subscription-and-redemption rankings showed a major reshuffle in cross-border money flows, with investors caught between fear of missing the rally and fear of buying at highs. Allocations favored strong technology themes alongside enhanced-income and multi-asset income products, while geographic preference broadened from the U.S. toward the Asia-Pacific region. The pattern reflects a "dual-engine" approach—pairing offensive tech exposure with defensive income streams—that wealth managers are increasingly recommending to high-net-worth clients navigating stretched valuations. For private-banking and wealth desks, the flows signal demand for barbell portfolios that capture AI-driven upside while cushioning against volatility through yield.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 月配息股票型ETF增至約20檔
items.title_en: Monthly-dividend equity ETFs proliferate to about 20 in Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 台灣掛牌的月配息股票型 ETF 檔數已攀升至約20檔，凸顯收益型商品持續主導散戶與小資族的需求。月配設計對追求穩定現金流的投資人具吸引力，尤以退休族與建構收益階梯者為然，發行商也以高股息與因子策略等日益多元的產品回應。此趨勢為財管客戶帶來實務考量：更換配息銀行的匯費、配息的課稅方式，以及帳面配息率究竟反映可持續的收益或本金返還。理財顧問日益強調以總報酬檢視並分散布局，提醒在月配息商品擁擠的市場中，應仔細審視標的成分與費用結構，避免只看高配息率而忽略長期實質報酬。
items.summary_en: The number of monthly-distributing equity ETFs listed in Taiwan has climbed to roughly 20, underscoring how income-focused products continue to dominate retail and mass-affluent demand. Monthly payouts appeal to investors seeking steady cash flow, particularly retirees and those building income ladders, and issuers have responded with a widening menu of high-dividend and factor-based strategies. The trend raises practical considerations for wealth clients—transfer fees between distribution banks, tax treatment of distributions, and whether headline yields reflect sustainable income or capital return. Advisers increasingly stress total-return analysis and diversification, cautioning that a crowded monthly-dividend field warrants scrutiny of underlying holdings and expense structures.

items.title_zh: 私人銀行門檻界定台灣高資產競逐
items.title_en: Private-banking thresholds anchor Taiwan's high-net-worth race
items.summary_zh: 高資產客戶爭奪戰持續白熱化，各行的進入門檻反映其如何切分財富金字塔。星展頂級私人客戶身分要求月均總資產達新台幣1億元或等值外幣；本土業者則設分級門檻，例如台新富裕會員要求往來資產連續3個月平均達新台幣100萬元以上。這些門檻勾勒出從小資富裕到超高資產的服務階梯，愈往上，家族信託、結構型商品與傳承規劃愈成為核心。隨台灣家庭財富累積與世代移轉，銀行競相以顧問深度、境外商品取得管道與傳承規劃專業做出區隔，而非僅以利率競爭，財管2.0下的差異化能力成為決勝關鍵。
items.summary_en: Competition for high-net-worth clients remains intense, with entry thresholds signaling how banks segment the wealth pyramid. DBS's top-tier private-client status requires average total assets of NT$100 million or foreign-currency equivalent, while local players set graduated tiers—Taishin's affluent membership, for example, asks for three consecutive months averaging NT$1 million in assets under management. These thresholds frame the service ladder from mass-affluent to ultra-high-net-worth, where family trusts, structured products and succession planning become central. As Taiwanese families accumulate and transfer wealth, banks are racing to differentiate through advisory depth, offshore product access and legacy-planning expertise rather than rates alone.

items.title_zh: 財政部研擬收緊「擬制遺產」規範
items.title_en: MOF drafts tighter "deemed estate" rules on pre-death gifts
items.summary_zh: 財政部預告修正遺產及贈與稅法，擬強化「擬制遺產」課稅邏輯：往生者過世前兩年內贈與親屬的財產，將併入遺產總額課稅，且該部分遺產稅由受贈人單獨負擔。此修法針對常見的傳承策略——臨終前短期內移轉資產以壓低遺產稅基。若三讀通過，將對傳承規劃產生實質影響，促使家庭提早啟動世代移轉並妥善留存贈與軌跡。理財顧問預期，能因應更嚴格回溯期與受贈人負稅規定的信託架構、保單與分年贈與策略需求將明顯升高。對高資產客戶而言，及早、分階段且合法留痕的傳承布局，將比臨門一腳的資產移轉更能有效控管稅負與家族紛爭風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance is previewing an amendment to the Estate and Gift Tax Act that would sharpen the "deemed estate" logic: property gifted to relatives within two years before death would be pulled back into the taxable estate, with the estate tax on those assets borne solely by the recipient. The change targets a common succession strategy of transferring assets shortly before death to reduce the estate base. If enacted, it would materially affect legacy planning, pushing families to start intergenerational transfers earlier and to document gifts carefully. Advisers expect heightened demand for trust structures, insurance and staged gifting strategies that anticipate the tighter look-back and recipient-liability rules.

items.title_zh: 2026年贈與稅、遺產稅免稅額維持不變
items.title_en: 2026 gift- and estate-tax allowances hold steady
items.summary_zh: 民國115年（2026年）台灣贈與稅免稅額維持每位贈與人每年新台幣244萬元，遺產稅免稅額為1,333萬元，各項扣除額與課稅級距金額由國稅機關公告。免稅額維持不變，意味家庭應善用每年244萬元的贈與額度，長期分年移轉財富以達節稅效果。由於免稅額與級距會定期依物價調整，顧問建議在執行大額移轉前先確認當年度數字。此一穩定架構凸顯長線、分年漸進贈與策略的價值——尤其搭配財政部研擬收緊「臨終前贈與」規定後，臨門一腳的資產移轉成本升高，及早規劃的重要性更為明顯，也讓年度贈與與保單、信託的組合運用成為傳承主流工具。
items.summary_en: For 2026 (民國115年), Taiwan's gift-tax exemption remains NT$2.44 million per donor per year, while the estate-tax exemption stands at NT$13.33 million, with statutory deductions and bracket thresholds published by the National Taxation authorities. Holding the allowances steady means families should plan annual gifting within the NT$2.44 million ceiling to transfer wealth tax-efficiently over time. Because exemptions and brackets are periodically indexed, advisers recommend confirming the current-year figures before executing large transfers. The stable framework reinforces the value of long-horizon, incremental gifting strategies—especially when paired with the MOF's proposed tightening of pre-death gift rules, which raises the cost of last-minute transfers.

items.title_zh: 個人交易特定股權恐須申報房地合一稅
items.title_en: Certain equity transfers may trigger house-and-land tax filing
items.summary_zh: 稅捐機關提醒，個人交易特定股權，於符合一定條件時，應申報房地合一所得稅；房地合一稅2.0自110年7月1日起實施。此規定旨在防止納稅人以移轉持有不動產公司股權的方式，規避不動產交易所得課稅。凡出售價值主要來自不動產之公司股權者，應評估交易是否落入「實質認定」範圍並依規申報。此提醒反映主管機關對間接移轉不動產的持續查核——此領域正是高資產重組與家族資產移轉容易在不經意間產生申報義務之處，若疏忽恐遭補稅與裁罰。建議相關交易前先諮詢專業意見，確認課稅身分與申報時點，避免因架構設計而觸法。
items.summary_en: Tax authorities reminded taxpayers that individuals transferring specific equity interests may, under defined conditions, be required to file house-and-land unified income tax (房地合一稅), which has applied under its 2.0 framework since July 1, 2021. The rule aims to prevent taxpayers from using share transfers of property-holding entities to sidestep real-estate capital-gains taxation. Sellers of shares in companies whose value derives substantially from real property should assess whether their transaction falls within the look-through provisions and file accordingly. The reminder reflects continued enforcement focus on indirect property transfers, an area where high-net-worth restructuring and family asset transfers can inadvertently create filing obligations and penalties if overlooked.

items.title_zh: 油價飆升重燃通膨風險，市場緊盯Fed
items.title_en: Oil spike revives inflation risk as markets watch the Fed
items.summary_zh: 荷莫茲海峽附近油輪遇襲、美國撤銷伊朗售油許可，觸發原油價格急漲，將供給衝擊風險重新帶回全球通膨展望。能源成本走高使央行決策更趨複雜，正值交易員權衡聯準會（Fed）政策路徑之際，市場在地緣風險溢價與利率預期之間拉鋸。對能源進口、出口導向的台灣而言，油價若持續走強將推升進口成本與國內物價，牽動央行對通膨與匯率的考量。決策者面臨微妙平衡：新一輪能源衝擊恐延後全球降息時程、收緊金融環境，即使 AI 循環仍提供成長動能，通膨與利率的兩難仍將主導下半年的政策節奏與市場情緒。
items.summary_en: A sharp rise in crude prices, triggered by tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and Washington's revocation of Iran's oil-sale license, has reintroduced supply-shock risk into the global inflation outlook. Higher energy costs complicate central-bank calculus just as traders weigh the path of Federal Reserve policy, with markets torn between geopolitical premium and rate expectations. For Taiwan, an energy-importing, export-oriented economy, sustained oil strength would pressure import costs and domestic prices, feeding into the central bank's own inflation and exchange-rate considerations. Policymakers face a delicate balance: a renewed energy shock could delay rate relief globally, tightening financial conditions even as growth momentum from the AI cycle continues.

items.title_zh: 利率與強勢美元考驗黃金避險角色
items.title_en: Gold's safe-haven role tested by yields and a firm dollar
items.summary_zh: 在伊朗衝突期間，黃金傳統的避險吸引力表現異常，甚至一度在地緣壓力下走跌——因美國公債殖利率上升與美元走強，推高持有無收益資產的機會成本。分析師指出，短期內高實質利率與美元強勢可壓過地緣風險溢價，惟當緊張情勢緩解、殖利率回落時，金價亦曾大幅反彈。此一插曲說明利率、匯率與風險偏好等總經驅動因子，對避險資金流向的影響可能大於新聞標題所暗示。對台灣投資人與財管業者而言，這強化了應以多元避險工具分散風險、而非單獨仰賴黃金作為危機緩衝的論點，凸顯資產配置中組合式對沖的重要性。
items.summary_en: Gold's traditional safe-haven appeal has behaved unexpectedly during the Iran conflict, at times falling even amid geopolitical stress as rising U.S. Treasury yields and a firm dollar raised the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset. Analysts note that in the short term, high real rates and dollar strength can outweigh the geopolitical premium, though gold has also rebounded sharply when tensions eased and yields fell. The episode illustrates how macro drivers—rates, currency and risk appetite—can dominate haven flows more than headlines suggest. For Taiwanese investors and wealth managers, it reinforces the case for diversified hedges rather than reliance on gold alone as a crisis buffer.

items.title_zh: 美股科技與晶片股重挫，壓抑亞洲市場
items.title_en: U.S. tech and chip stocks tumble, pressuring Asian markets
items.summary_zh: 美股半導體族群7月7日賣壓沉重，三星財報雖創獲利新高，仍未能跨越市場對 AI 的高門檻，拖累那斯達克下跌約1%，並擴散至亞洲科技股。設備與晶片股領跌，此波賣壓再度印證「優於預期已不保證正面反應」的趨勢。此一走弱為台股當日的重挫定調，凸顯本地科技估值與美股情緒高度連動。對台灣投資人而言，這提醒 AI 行情的全球連動性是雙面刃——上漲時放大漲幅，預期重設時亦放大跌幅，凸顯在高估值階段更須留意跨市場情緒的傳導與風險控管。
items.summary_en: Wall Street's semiconductor complex sold off on July 7 as Samsung's earnings, despite record profit, failed to clear the market's elevated AI bar, dragging the Nasdaq roughly 1% lower and rippling into Asian tech shares. Equipment and chip names led declines, with the selloff reinforcing a growing pattern where beating estimates no longer guarantees a positive reaction. The weakness set the tone for Taiwan's own sharp pullback, underscoring how tightly local tech valuations track U.S. sentiment. For Taiwanese investors, the episode is a reminder that the AI trade's global linkages cut both ways—amplifying gains in rallies and losses when expectations reset.

items.title_zh: 荷莫茲海峽攻擊引爆油價飆升，撼動全球能源市場
items.title_en: Oil surge on Hormuz attacks jolts global energy markets
items.summary_zh: 伊朗在承載全球約20%石油運輸的荷莫茲海峽附近攻擊油輪、美國撤銷伊朗售油許可後，全球能源市場劇烈震盪，布蘭特與西德州原油大幅走高。供給中斷疑慮再起，凸顯美伊臨時和平的脆弱，並使能源重回總經敘事核心。對包括台灣在內、仰賴進口的亞洲經濟體而言，油價若持續走揚，恐推升製造與運輸的投入成本。交易員正緊盯衝突是否擴大——若然，原油將續含地緣風險溢價，並使各國央行原本仰賴的通膨降溫路徑更趨複雜，牽動下半年利率與匯率政策的想像空間。
items.summary_en: Global energy markets were shaken after Iran attacked tankers near the Strait of Hormuz—which handles about 20% of the world's oil traffic—and the U.S. revoked Iran's oil-sale license, sending Brent and WTI sharply higher. The renewed supply-disruption fears reaffirmed the fragility of the interim U.S.-Iran peace and pushed energy to the center of the macro narrative. For import-dependent Asian economies, including Taiwan, a sustained oil rally threatens to lift input costs across manufacturing and transport. Traders are now watching whether the escalation broadens, which would keep a geopolitical risk premium embedded in crude and complicate the disinflation path that central banks have been counting on.

items.title_zh: 美股期指走平，市場聚焦伊朗與Fed（2026-07-08）
items.title_en: U.S. stock futures trade flat with Iran and the Fed in focus (2026-07-08)
items.summary_zh: 週三盤前，標普500、那斯達克與道瓊期指在平盤附近游走，投資人一面權衡升溫的伊朗緊張情勢，一面關注聯準會政策展望。此謹慎氛圍出自美方強硬回應——美軍週二晚間對伊朗發動打擊，以報復荷莫茲海峽商船遇襲事件。美國財政部撤銷伊朗石油出口許可後，能源市場續處緊繃。
items.summary_en: S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow futures hovered near the flatline heading into Wednesday as investors weighed escalating Iran tensions against the outlook for Federal Reserve policy. The cautious tone followed a sharp U.S. response after American forces struck Iran late Tuesday, retaliating for attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Energy markets stayed on edge after the Treasury revoked Iran's oil-export license.

items.title_zh: 荷莫茲海峽油輪遇襲，油價走高（2026-07-07）
items.title_en: Oil prices rise after tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz (2026-07-07)
items.summary_zh: 週二伊朗於荷莫茲海峽附近攻擊一艘卡達 LNG 油輪、另一艘船則遭不明投射物擊中後，油價上漲。布蘭特原油收漲約3%至每桶74.16美元、西德州收70.44美元；美國撤銷伊朗售油許可後，盤後續漲，布蘭特一度升5.6%至76.04美元，供給中斷疑慮再起。
items.summary_en: Oil rose Tuesday after Iran attacked a Qatari LNG tanker near the Strait of Hormuz and another vessel was hit by an unidentified projectile. Brent settled about 3% higher at $74.16 and WTI at $70.44, then extended gains in after-hours trade—Brent up 5.6% to $76.04—after the U.S. revoked Iran's oil-sale license, reviving supply-disruption fears.

items.title_zh: 三星財報不及AI高標，晶片股賣壓（2026-07-07）
items.title_en: Chip stocks sell off after Samsung earnings fall short of high AI bar (2026-07-07)
items.summary_zh: 週二三星財報雖獲利大增，卻未達華爾街對 AI 需求的高度期待，投資人拋售半導體股。三星股價下跌約8%，晶片族群普遍走弱，那斯達克開盤約下跌1%。此走勢延續了「強勁財報已不足以取悅 AI 行情投資人」的現象。
items.summary_en: Investors dumped semiconductor stocks Tuesday after Samsung's results failed to meet Wall Street's lofty AI-demand expectations, even as quarterly profit surged. Samsung shares fell around 8%, and the broad chip complex weakened, with the Nasdaq opening about 1% lower. The move extended a pattern where strong earnings alone no longer satisfy investors in the AI trade.

items.title_zh: 三星獲利創紀錄，股價仍下挫（2026-07-07）
items.title_en: Samsung posts record profit but shares slide (2026-07-07)
items.summary_zh: 三星公布2026年第二季初步營業利益約580億美元，年增達19倍且優於預期，惟首爾股價盤中一度重挫達10%。此反應反映市場對 AI 的高度期待，財報仍難以超越，呼應海外其他 AI 相關個股先前財報後回檔的情況。
items.summary_en: Samsung reported preliminary Q2 2026 operating profit of about $58 billion, a 19-fold jump from a year earlier that beat estimates, yet shares fell as much as 10% intraday in Seoul. The reaction reflected sky-high AI expectations the results couldn't exceed, mirroring post-earnings pullbacks seen earlier in other AI-linked names abroad.

items.title_zh: 英特爾、應用材料、超微在晶片賣壓中重挫（2026-07-07）
items.title_en: Intel, Applied Materials and AMD plunge in chip rout (2026-07-07)
items.summary_zh: 三星財報引爆半導體全面走弱，美國晶片設備與處理器廠領跌，應用材料下跌約10%、超微下滑約8%。iShares 半導體 ETF 下跌約6%，凸顯儘管 AI 循環基本面仍強，族群情緒仍迅速轉弱。
items.summary_en: U.S. chip equipment and processor makers led the selloff, with Applied Materials down about 10% and AMD sliding around 8% after Samsung's report triggered a broad semiconductor decline. The iShares Semiconductor ETF fell roughly 6%, underscoring how quickly sentiment turned across the group despite the AI cycle's underlying strength.

items.title_zh: 伊朗戰事下，黃金避險角色演變（2026-07-04）
items.title_en: Gold's safe-haven appeal evolves amid the Iran war (2026-07-04)
items.summary_zh: 在伊朗衝突期間，黃金作為危機避險工具的表現異常，甚至一度在緊張情勢中走跌——因公債殖利率上升與美元走強，推高這項無收益金屬的機會成本。分析師指出，短期內總經因子可壓過地緣風險溢價，惟當緊張緩解、殖利率回落時，金價亦曾反彈。
items.summary_en: Gold's role as a crisis hedge has behaved unusually during the Iran conflict, at times falling even amid tension as rising Treasury yields and a firm dollar raised the opportunity cost of the non-yielding metal. Analysts say macro drivers can dominate the geopolitical premium in the short term, though gold rebounded when tensions eased and yields fell.
